title: Felix and the Undertow
author: Zephyrine Eastwick
blurb: Ada Okonkwo, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
